gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-thai: Chunky, wide, unapologetic: Dogica stamps its heavy capitals and near-capital lowercase across the top, while Noto Sans Thai rounds out the text below. Inflated, open shapes.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh fills its lines with rounded, open bowls. Dogica is the loud one, wide and heavy and commanding, while the sans below simply stays inviting and clean.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Commanding from the first word, Dogica spreads its heavy, widely tracked letters across the top. Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps things approachable below, with open mouths and barely any gap between small and capital height.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-orienta: Orienta reads modern and level, its breathing counters barely separating lowercase from capitals. Dogica's wide, heavy lettering above gives the page a firm voice, and the plain sans below lets it speak softly.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads clean and contemporary, with open curves. Dogica is built for heavy, wide statements, whereas the sans-serif below does its best work being quietly consistent in its near-capital lowercase.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-parkinsans: Contemporary in feel, Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout and stays crisp when small. And Dogica supplies the muscle, heavy and widely tracked, while the sans-serif handles the quiet, unvarying work.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-puritan: Puritan reads open and friendly. Over a long stretch, its oversized e and a counters would feel easy and unhurried beneath Dogica's wide, heavy, commanding headings.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-questrial: Dogica is heavy and commanding. It hammers out wide, near-capital lowercase, while Questrial, the sans-serif below, stays crisp and modern with single-weight strokes and open c, e, and s shapes.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada draws a steady, pressure-free line. Its tall, full c, s and z meet Dogica's heavy, wide-set capitals in a sans and display mix with a blueprint-like consistency.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sarpanch: Blocky and bold, wide and weighty. Dogica commands attention with its heavy, widely tracked letters, while the sans below keeps an approachable open e and a compact, tidy height.
